schools.title: Schools
schools.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, city, census number or staff prefix
schools.emptyBody: Try a different search or filter.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Open reports about schools, newest first.

confirmDisable.title: Disable {{name}}?
confirmDisable.body: Admins and teachers can still sign in, but they will only see a "school suspended" screen and can't use the app until you enable it again.

releaseCensus.title: Release census number {{censusNo}}?
releaseCensus.body: This removes census number {{censusNo}} from {{name}} so another school can register with it. {{name}} keeps its data but will have no census number. This cannot be undone. Usually done after disabling a fake or squatting registration.

toast.cleared: Census number {{censusNo}} cleared from {{name}} (it was not reserved for this school)

usage.title: Usage
usage.intro: Record counts per school. The entries count covers the active year only.

subjects.title: Default subjects
subjects.intro: The standard list schools can load into their own subjects.
subjects.emptyBody: Add the first subject to build the standard list.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.body: It is removed from the standard list. Schools that already loaded it keep their copy.

terms.title: Terms and privacy
terms.intro: Published versions of the terms and privacy policy. Newest first.
terms.warning: Publishing makes this the current version. Every school admin will be asked to accept it again before they can continue.
terms.configError: Could not load the current version, so none is marked.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.intro: A banner shown to school admins while it is active.
announcements.textSiHint: Leave empty to show the English message to everyone.

errors.denied: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.stale: The school sent a newer name change request. Check it and decide again.

review.title: Review
review.duplicatesHint: Same school under another name or census number? Reject, or ask the admin to join the existing school.
review.moeNote: Similar names in the MOE list are in the review email.
review.footer: Approving turns on publishing, printing, auto-fill and invites, and emails the school admin. Rejecting emails them your reason.
review.reasonSent: Reason sent to the school admin
review.rejectBody: The school admin gets an email with your reason and sees a "Not approved" screen. They can contact Sathiya or remove the registration.
review.reasonPlaceholder: For example: We couldn't confirm that you work at this school.
review.reasonHint: Write it for the school admin. It goes in the email as you type it.
review.reasonRequired: Enter a reason. The school admin will see it.
review.toastApproved: {{name}} approved. The school admin was emailed.
review.toastRejected: Registration rejected. Email sent with your reason.

nameChange.title: Name change
nameChange.rejectBody: The school keeps its current name. The school admin gets an email with your reason and sees it on the profile page.
nameChange.reasonSent: Reason sent to the school admin
nameChange.footer: Approving renames the school everywhere, including published timetables and the directory, and emails the school admin.
nameChange.toastApproved: New name approved. The school admin was emailed.
nameChange.toastRejected: Name change rejected. Email sent with your reason.
